text: Fish and I established martial law at the Dover house, and prevented the Comrades from communicating with the false Lemoine. He sent them an order to clear out, and word was conveyed to him that this had been done. So he went happily ahead with his plans for denouncing me.” “Well, well,” said Lord Caterham cheerfully, “everything seems to have been cleared up most satisfactorily.” “Everything but one thing,” said Mr. Isaacstein. “What is that?” The great financier looked steadily at Anthony. “What did you get me down here for?
